extraction_notes: CO2 conversion was not reported for these plotted activity entries. Several values are only available as plotted bars/points and are marked with qualifier '~'. Figure 16 (methanol selectivity versus contact time) and Figure 17 (time-on-stream stability) contain additional plotted points, but exact coordinates are not printed; Figure 16 overlaps with other condition series and has no schema field for contact time, and Figure 17 is a dense stability trace, so those individual plot points were not enumerated. Supporting Information tables/figures were referenced but not included in the supplied full text/images.
